# HtnPriority

[API index](../index.md)

Interruption-strength ordering for HTN goals/tasks/behaviors. The derived `Ord` follows declaration
order (`Background` < … < `Critical`); the executor blocks injection for any priority at-or-below
the active chain (only strictly-higher preempts).

## NoActive

```typescript
NoActive = -1,
```

Internal sentinel used when no chain is active.

## Background

```typescript
Background = 0,
```

Background work such as long patrols and passive roaming.

## Opportunity

```typescript
Opportunity = 1,
```

Optional work that may interrupt background plans but should not displace normal actions.

## Normal

```typescript
Normal = 2,
```

Ordinary explicit user intent such as a one-off move or selection command.

## Combat

```typescript
Combat = 3,
```

Combat work that may interrupt travel, pickups, and other ordinary automation.

## Danger

```typescript
Danger = 4,
```

Fast reaction work for dangerous game mechanics.

## Critical

```typescript
Critical = 5,
```

Highest-priority emergency work.
